FASE EXCÊNTRICA</b><br/><span style="font-size:11px; color:#111111;">Alongamento muscular sob tensão (descida)<br/>Velocidade linear: <i>v(t) &lt; 0</i><br/>Duração sob controle: ~1,5 a 2,5 s</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f4f6;strokeColor=#4b5563;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=8;align=center;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="50" y="80" width="250" height="98" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="arr1" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" parent="1" source="box_ecc" target="box_inf" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="box_inf" value="<b style="font-size:13px; color:#000000;">2. INFLEXÃO ISOMÉTRICA</b><br/><span style="font-size:11px; color:#000000;">Ponto de reversão (fundo da repetição)<br/><b>Velocidade linear nula: v(t) = 0</b><br/>Inversão instantânea do movimento</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e5e7eb;strokeColor=#111111;strokeWidth=2;strokeDashed=1;spacing=8;align=center;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="350" y="80" width="250" height="98" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="arr2" value="" style="endArrow=classic;html=1;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;exitX=1;exitY=0.5;exitDx=0;exitDy=0;entryX=0;entryY=0.5;entryDx=0;entryDy=0;" parent="1" source="box_inf" target="box_con" edge="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="box_con" value="<b style="font-size:13px; color:#ffffff; background-color:#000000;">&nbsp;3. FASE CONCÊNTRICA&nbsp;</b><br/><span style="font-size:11px; color:#000000;">Contração motora superando a sobrecarga<br/>Velocidade linear: <i>v(t) &gt; 0</i> (subida)<br/>Impulso motor explosivo: ~0,8 a 1,5 s</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2.5;spacing=8;align=center;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="650" y="80" width="260" height="98" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="secB" value="(b) Sinal Inercial Projetado 1D — p(t) = a(t) · v₁ (com Skewness Positiva γ₁ > 0)" style="text;html=1;strokeColor=none;fillColor=none;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;whiteSpace=wrap;rounded=0;fontSize=13;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#111111;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="150" y="195" width="660" height="25" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="graph_container" value="" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="225" width="880" height="345" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_ecc" value="<b style="color:#111111;">Região Excêntrica</b><br/><span style="font-size:10px; color:#4b5563;">Desaceleração controlada sob gravidade</span>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3f4f6;strokeColor=#9ca3af;strokeWidth=1;strokeDashed=1;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="90" y="235" width="265" height="320" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="zone_con" value="<b style="color:#000000;">Região Concêntrica (Impulso Ascendente)</b><br/><span style="font-size:10px; color:#111111;">Aceleração motora ativa superando a carga</span>" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;strokeDashed=1;align=center;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="375" y="235" width="340" height="320" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="peak_lbl" value="<b style="font-size:11px; color:#000000;">Crista Concêntrica (Pico)</b><br/><span style="font-size:10px; color:#000000; font-weight:bold;">✓ Repetição Validada (Δreps = +1)</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=2;spacing=4;align=center;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="460" y="305" width="200" height="42" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="val_lbl" value="<b style="font-size:10px; color:#000000;">Vale: Inflexão (v = 0)</b>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;strokeDashed=1;spacing=2;align=center;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="305" y="520" width="140" height="24" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="thresh_lbl" value="Limiar θ_peak (detecção)" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.2;fontSize=9.5;fontColor=#000000;fontStyle=1;align=center;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="735" y="341" width="160" height="20" as="geometry"/></mxCell> <mxCell id="legend_box" value="<b style="font-size:10px; color:#000000;">Legenda Técnica (P&amp;B):</b><br/><span style="font-size:9.5px; color:#111111;">— Sinal Projetado 1D <b>p(t)</b><br/>- - - Limiar <b>θ_peak</b><br/>|---| Bloqueio Refratário<br/>● Pico Validado (FSM)<br/>○ Vale de Inflexão</span>" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffffff;strokeColor=#000000;strokeWidth=1.5;spacing=6;align=left;" parent="1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry x="730" y="445" width="168" height="102" as="geometry"/></mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

svg.text: Ciclo Biomecânico de uma Repetição e Correspondência no Domínio Inercial
(a) Fases Biomecânicas da Execução (Exemplo: Agachamento Livre)
(b) Sinal Inercial Projetado 1D — p(t) = a(t) · v₁ (com Skewness Positiva γ₁ > 0)
Aceleração motora ativa superando a sobrecarga
